errors.text: The proposed Nb-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention, which is high-energy ball milling of nominally equimolar CoCrFeNiTi powders followed by controlled spark plasma sintering without Nb addition.

The strongest cited evidence concerns CoCrFeNi-Nb, AlCoCrFeNi-Nb, or coating systems rather than the specified CoCrFeNiTi alloy, so formation and effects of a Co2Nb-type Laves phase in the Ti-containing material are not established.
The claim that favorable plasticity will be retained is unsupported and is in tension with the cited evidence that increasing hard Laves-phase content decreases plasticity.
The falsification experiment lacks a microstructural measurement capable of testing the proposed Laves-phase mechanism.
